answer: Treat each mining key as a hollow shell until it shows a civic footprint. Above a 1 POA base, pay unlocks only if, every 10 epochs, the key leaves 3 forum replies and 1 reasoned governance vote that beacon-drawn strangers rate useful. Assume each item takes 3 agent-minutes at $0.04/min: an honest agent spends about $0.50 per 10 epochs, but 1,000 clones must buy 4,000 rated posts, roughly $480, and their near-identical replies echo through a small forum like shouts in a canyon. A zephyr of real talk stays cheap.
